facts.fact: AFRICLOUD launched its Lagos region on 2026-08-10 (date from the article), with cloud and dedicated servers open to all customers and physically hosted in an unnamed carrier-neutral data centre in Lagos's central business district.
facts.system: AFRICLOUD Lagos region (carrier-neutral data centre, Lagos CBD)

facts.fact: AFRICLOUD, a cloud infrastructure provider, launched its third region, Lagos, as a full compute location alongside Lisbon and Johannesburg, with orders open to everyone, per tech.africa on 2026-08-10 (date from the article).
